name: absence-eval-case
procedure: add a walkthrough-card eval case to Concept Buddy
why: The third run of this procedure and the first captured entirely by a fixed pipeline — no replay, no tuning. One episode straight from the live hooks, titled from its own commit. The two before it banked six and five fragments respectively.
history: With the other two, this is what first carried a real procedure past the recurrence threshold: replayed together they merge to one entry at x3 with three variants and ready=True. Three variants also showed that `step_shape` cannot find the method — it keeps 31 of 36 steps, 21 of them undifferentiated `bash:grep` — while a shape that preserves command arguments keeps exactly the six the three runs agree on: the adk-docs fetch, the read, and the edit.

input.text: Use the adk-docs MCP tool to look up how ADK eval cases and evalsets are structured — don't answer from memory, actually fetch the docs first.

We have no coverage for the absence.io walkthrough card. TOPICS["absence"] in book.py stages a walkthrough card with body absence, and no case asserts it. Add one to eval/cases.json — expect_card with variant walkthrough and body_contains: "absence" — matching the format of geco_timesheet_card_staged.

Before you commit — check the docstring in concept_buddy_agent/book.py. It says the TOPICS table is the single source of truth for KB cards, moved out of the skill prompt so staging is deterministic. Confirm that still holds: absence is only in TOPICS, cards.stage is still the only writer, nothing crept back into a skill prompt

input.description: Find all absence mentions in agent

input.text: Commit. If regenerating left indent churn in cases.json, leave it — do not git checkout the file, just commit what's there.

input.command:
git add backend/concept_buddy_agent/eval/cases.json backend/concept_buddy_agent/eval/concept_buddy.evalset.json && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test(eval): add walkthrough-card case for absence.io

Guards book.TOPICS["absence"] staging a walkthrough card with body="absence"
(the absence.io click-through). Sibling to geco_timesheet_card_staged and
wk_desk_booking_card; the KB-path card was previously uncovered.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" && git status --short
